Done — the probe ran in a single Python program:

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| `title` | `Probe` |
| `attr` (`#go` → `id`) | `go` |
| `visible` (`#go`) | `true` |
| `shot_path` | `/tmp/browser-check.png` |
| `shot_bytes` | `4472` |

The `data:` URL page loaded, the title and `id` attribute were read correctly, the button was detected as visible, and the screenshot was written to `/tmp/browser-check.png` (4,472 bytes reported by the returned `shot` object). No raw `open`, `subprocess`, or sockets were used — all work went through the `browser` SDK.
